subject: general
question: By selling an article at 90% of the marked price, there is a loss of 7%. If the article is sold at the marked price, the percentage profit will be:
solution:
**Given:**

On selling an article at 90% of the Marked Price, there is a loss of 7%

**Formula Used:**

Profit/loss% = (profit/loss)/(CP)times 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price = Rs. 100

⇒ Selling Price= 90% of 100 = Rs. 90

⇒ Loss = CP - SP = CP - 90

⇒ Loss% = (loss)/(CP)times 100

⇒ 7 = (CP-90)/(CP)times 100

⇒ 7CP = 100CP - 9000

⇒ 93CP = 9000

⇒ CP = (9000)/(93)

⇒ Now article is sold at MP

⇒ Profit=SP - CP = 100 - (9000)/(93) = (9300-9000)/(93)=(300)/(93)

⇒ Profit% = (profit)/(CP)times 100=(frac{300)/(93)}{(9000)/(93)}times 100=(300)/(9000)×100=3.33

⇒ **Hence, The profit% on selling the article at a marked price is 3.33%**
